fullDescription: A warm sunset-gradient SaaS marketing landing page on a cream canvas: coral-to-amber accents, a sticky blurred nav, a gradient hero with a faux infinite-canvas product mock, a 6-card feature grid, template showcase, a dark stats band, testimonial, and a burnt-orange CTA, all in Plus Jakarta Sans.
prompt:
## Resumo A warm, sunset-gradient SaaS marketing landing page on a cream canvas with a coral-to-amber accent system. A sticky blurred nav sits above a centered hero (pill badge, a large display headline with a coral->amber gradient-clipped phrase, subcopy, two CTAs, and a faux 'infinite canvas' product mock framed in a grainy card with floating chips), a trust logo strip, a 6-card feature grid, a 3-up template-gallery showcase (one tall featured card), a dark charcoal stats band with amber glows and 4 metrics, a single centered testimonial, a deep burnt-orange gradient closing CTA panel, and a dark 4-column footer. The signature is the warm sunset palette (coral #ff6b4a + amber #ffb020 on cream #fff8f1), Plus Jakarta Sans throughout, pill-shaped gradient buttons, soft glowing shadows, and a subtle dotted film-grain overlay on the feature panels. ## Estilo Visual Warm sunset SaaS landing page on a cream canvas with a coral-to-amber accent. Exact palette via tailwind.config: ink #1c1410 (text + dark sections), coral #ff6b4a, amber #ffb020, cream #fff8f1 (page bg), sand #fdeede (warmer wash). Body is bg-cream text-ink; secondary text is ink at ~60-70% opacity (text-ink/60, text-ink/65, text-ink/70); borders are orange-100 / orange-100/70. The primary accent everywhere is a linear gradient from coral to amber (bg-gradient-to-r/br from-coral to-amber) used on pill buttons, square icon chips, and decorative blobs. Headline accent words use a clipped text gradient: background: linear-gradient(96deg,#ff6b4a 0%,#ff8a3d 45%,#ffb020 100%) with -webkit-background-clip:text and transparent fill (class .sunset-text). Custom shadows: card = 0 1px 2px rgba(28,20,16,.04), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(255,107,74,.22); glow = 0 18px 50px -12px rgba(255,107,74,.55); soft = 0 1px 2px rgba(28,20,16,.05), 0 8px 24px -16px rgba(28,20,16,.25). Hero/feature/showcase backdrops layer soft blurred radial blobs: a big amber/40->coral/30->transparent blur-3xl ellipse top-center, plus smaller coral/20 blobs. Dark sections use bg-ink (#1c1410) with coral/50->amber/40 and amber/40->coral/30 radial blur blobs; the closing CTA uses a bg-gradient-to-br from #d63a14 via #c2410c to #b45309 (deep burnt orange). Text selection ::selection is bg #ffd9b3 on #1c1410. Font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights 400-800) as the only family (font-sans), antialiased, text-rendering optimizeLegibility, smooth scroll. A subtle grain overlay (.grain::before): radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.5) 1px, transparent 1px) at 22px 22px, opacity .4, on framed panels. Icons are inline Phosphor-style SVG glyphs (waves/sun logo, arrow-right, sparkle, play-circle, magic-wand, palette, code, chat, devices, stars, quotes, social) tinted white on gradient chips or coral/amber inline. ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky nav Sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) with a translucent cream bg (bg-cream/80) + backdrop-blur-md and a 1px bottom border in orange-100/70. Inside, mx-auto max-w-7xl, h-16 flex row, space-between, px-6 -> lg:px-8. Left = brand lockup: an 8x8 rounded-lg coral->amber gradient square (shadow-glow) holding a small white waves/sun glyph, beside the wordmark 'Solflare' in font-extrabold tracking-tight. Center (hidden lg:flex) = nav links Features / Templates / Results / Pricing in text-sm font-semibold ink/70 with hover:text-ink. Right = a 'Sign in' text link (hidden sm:block, ink/70) plus a 'Start free' pill button: rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-coral to-amber, white text, shadow-glow, a trailing arrow glyph, hover:brightness-105. ### Hero Relative overflow-hidden section with a layered warm backdrop (-z-10): a bg-gradient-to-b from-sand via-cream to-cream wash, a big -top-40 left-1/2 600px-tall amber/40->coral/30->transparent blur-3xl ellipse, and a smaller right-side coral/20 blur blob. Centered content mx-auto max-w-7xl, pt-16 -> lg:pt-24, pb-20, text-center. Top: an inline-flex rounded-full pill badge (border coral/30 on bg-white/70 backdrop-blur, shadow-soft) with a tiny coral->amber gradient sparkle chip, coral text 'New: 240+ conversion-tested SaaS layouts', and a trailing arrow. Then a max-w-4xl display headline: 'Ship a [SaaS site] that sells itself' where 'SaaS site' uses the .sunset-text clipped gradient and a desktop-only
. Then a max-w-xl ink/65 subhead: 'Prompt-library designs for landing pages, dashboards, and pricing flows. Pick a layout, tweak the copy, ship a site that actually converts. No designer needed.' CTA row (flex-col -> sm:flex-row, gap-3): primary pill 'Start designing free' (coral->amber gradient, white, shadow-glow, arrow) + secondary 'Watch the demo' pill (white bg, ink/15 border, shadow-soft, coral play-circle glyph, hover coral). Below: a tiny ink/70 reassurance line 'Free forever plan / No credit card / Export to React & Figma'. ### Hero product mock + floating chips Below the CTAs, a relative mx-auto max-w-5xl framed product preview: a .grain rounded-3xl card (border orange-100, bg-white, p-3, shadow-card) wrapping a rounded-2xl sand->cream gradient 'infinite canvas'. Inside, a top bar (border-b orange-100/70, px-5 py-3, space-between): left = a 6x6 coral->amber gradient chip with a waves glyph + 'Infinite canvas' label; right (hidden sm:flex) = a coral/10 'Generating...' pill and an amber/15 '4 variants' pill. Canvas body = a 12-col grid (p-5): a left col-span-4 white prompt card (border orange-100, shadow-soft) showing a coral 'PROMPT' eyebrow, a quoted example prompt, and 3 sand tag pills (Landing / Gradient / B2B); a right col-span-8 holding two skeleton mock cards (one plain, one highlighted with border-2 coral/40 + ring-2 coral/10) built from gradient header bars and rounded skeleton bars/buttons. Floating chips overlap the frame: an absolute -left-4 top-20 rotate-[-4deg] white pill 'Generated in 8s' (amber lightning glyph) and an absolute -right-5 bottom-16 rotate-[5deg] white pill 'Export / React' (coral upload glyph), both shadow-card, hidden until lg. ### Trust logo strip Centered mt-16 block: an uppercase tracked eyebrow in ink/35 'Trusted by 18,000+ builders & teams', then a flex-wrap row (gap-x-10 gap-y-4, justify-center, ink/35) of five faux company lockups, each a small Phosphor glyph + an extrabold wordmark: Northwind, Orbital, Hexly, Voltage, Cascade. ### Feature grid (6 cards) Section id=features, py-24. Centered header (max-w-2xl): a coral/10 rounded-full eyebrow pill with a stack glyph 'Everything you need', an H2 'From blank canvas to [shipped site]' (shipped site in .sunset-text), and an ink/60 subhead. Below, a grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3 (gap-6) of six cards. Each card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border orange-100 bg-white p-7 shadow-card, with a decorative corner blob (absolute right-0 top-0 24x24 rounded-bl-[3rem] coral/15->amber/15 gradient), a 12x12 rounded-xl coral->amber (alternating amber->coral) gradient icon chip with shadow-glow and a white glyph, an H3 (text-xl font-bold), and an ink/60 paragraph. Hover lifts the card -4px (class ring-card). Cards: (1) Prompt to layout, (2) Curated prompt library, (3) Export clean code, (4) Brand it in one click, (5) Built for coding agents, (6) Responsive by default, each with the matching descriptive copy. ### Template showcase Section id=showcase, relative overflow-hidden py-24, with a bg-gradient-to-b from-cream via-sand to-cream backdrop (-z-10). Header row (flex-col -> sm:flex-row, items-end, space-between): left = an amber/15 rounded-full eyebrow 'Template gallery' (squares glyph) + H2 'Start from a layout that already converts'; right = a white outline pill 'Browse all 240' with a trailing arrow. Below, a grid lg:grid-cols-3 (gap-6) of three article cards (ring-card hover lift). Card A is featured and lg:row-span-2 (tall): a .grain h-64 coral->amber gradient header containing a white/95 mini-card mock (skeleton bars + a gradient button) and a 3-up row of translucent blocks, then a body with title 'AI SaaS Landing', a coral/10 'Most used' badge, description, and a meta row (copy glyph '4.2k uses' + amber star '4.9'). Card B = 'Pricing & Plans' with a 3-col skeleton header (middle outlined coral/40). Card C = 'Analytics Dashboard' with a sidebar+content skeleton header. All cards rounded-2xl border orange-100 bg-white shadow-card. ### Stats band (dark) Section id=metrics. Inside mx-auto max-w-7xl py-20, a .grain rounded-3xl bg-ink (#1c1410) panel (px-8 py-14 -> sm:px-14, shadow-card) with two pointer-events-none radial blur blobs (coral/50->amber/40 top-right, amber/40->coral/30 bottom-left). Content grid lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_1.4fr], items-center, gap-10: left = H2 in cream 'Real strategies. / Real results.' (Real results. in .sunset-text) + an ink-on-cream subhead at cream/60; right = a 2x2 -> 4-up metric grid where each metric is a left coral/amber border accent (border-l-2 border-coral/50 or amber/50, pl-4) with a text-4xl extrabold cream value and a cream/45 uppercase label: 18k+ Builders, 240+ Prompt layouts, 8s Avg. generation, +34% Median lift. ### Testimonial A centered py-12 section, mx-auto max-w-4xl, text-center: a large coral/30 quotes glyph, then a text-2xl -> sm:text-3xl font-bold leading-snug pull-quote with one phrase ('three weeks') wrapped in .sunset-text, then an attribution row (justify-center, gap-3): an 11x11 coral->amber gradient circle avatar with white 'MK' initials, and a left-aligned name 'Maya Kapoor' / role 'Founder, Hexly' (ink/50). ### Closing CTA panel Section id=cta, px-6 py-20 -> lg:px-8. A .grain mx-auto max-w-6xl rounded-[2rem] panel with a deep burnt-orange gradient (bg-gradient-to-br from #d63a14 via #c2410c to #b45309), shadow-glow, px-8 py-20 -> sm:px-14, text-center, plus two amber/25 and coral/25 radial blur blobs. Content: an H2 in white (text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl extrabold) 'Your next SaaS site starts with one prompt', a white subline 'Join 18,000+ builders shipping better sites, faster. Free forever to start, no credit card.', a CTA row (flex-col -> sm:flex-row, gap-3): a solid bg-ink pill 'Start designing free' (white text, arrow) + a white/95 pill 'Talk to us' (ink text). Below, a tiny white reassurance line 'No credit card / Cancel anytime / Export to React & Figma'. ### Footer (dark) Footer on bg-ink, cream/70 text. mx-auto max-w-7xl py-16 -> lg:px-8. Top grid lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr], gap-12: first col = brand lockup (coral->amber gradient square + 'Solflare' in cream extrabold), a cream/45 max-w-xs blurb 'The prompt-library design agent for SaaS websites...', and a row of three 9x9 rounded-lg white/5 social icon buttons (X, Discord-style, YouTube) that hover to coral/20 + coral. Three link columns (Product / Resources / Company) each with an uppercase cream/40 heading and a space-y-3 list of cream links that hover:text-coral. Bottom: a mt-14 border-t white/10 pt-8 row (flex-col -> sm:flex-row, space-between, text-xs cream/40) with copyright 'c 2026 Solflare. All rights reserved.' and a Privacy / Terms / Security link group. ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Sunset gradient-clipped headline text — The recurring brand flourish: a key phrase in each big heading is rendered in a coral->orange->amber gradient clipped to the text, while the rest stays solid ink (or cream on dark sections). Define a .sunset-text utility: background: linear-gradient(96deg,#ff6b4a 0%,#ff8a3d 45%,#ffb020 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent. Wrap just the emphasis phrase in a inside an otherwise solid heading (e.g. 'Ship a [SaaS site] that sells itself', 'From blank canvas to [shipped site]', 'Real [results].', '[three weeks]'). Use it sparingly, one phrase per heading, so the gradient reads as an accent not a wash. ### Coral-to-amber gradient pill button — The primary CTA style: a fully rounded pill filled with the coral->amber gradient, white bold text, a trailing arrow glyph, and a warm coral glow shadow that brightens on hover. Build with inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-coral to-amber px-7 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-glow transition hover:brightness-105, plus a trailing Phosphor arrow-right SVG. The secondary/ghost variant is white bg with an ink/15 border + shadow-soft that gains a coral/40 border and coral text on hover. On dark sections the primary flips to solid bg-ink (white text) against the burnt-orange panel. ### Faux 'infinite canvas' product mock with floating chips — A framed, grainy product preview that fakes the app canvas: a top bar with status pills, a left prompt card with tag chips, and right skeleton design cards (one highlighted), with two rotated 'Generated in 8s' / 'Export / React' chips floating over the frame edges. Outer = .grain rounded-3xl border orange-100 bg-white p-3 shadow-card wrapping a rounded-2xl sand->cream gradient. Top bar: 6x6 coral->amber chip + 'Infinite canvas', plus right-side coral/10 'Generating...' and amber/15 '4 variants' pills. Body = sm:grid-cols-12: a col-span-4 white prompt card (coral 'PROMPT' eyebrow, quoted prompt, 3 sand tag pills) + a col-span-8 pair of skeleton design cards built from gradient header bars (h-14 coral->amber and amber/20->coral/20) and rounded ink/10 skeleton bars + tiny coral/sand buttons; the second card is highlighted (border-2 coral/40 ring-2 coral/10). Floating chips: absolute -left-4 top-20 rotate-[-4deg] white pill 'Generated in 8s' (amber lightning) and absolute -right-5 bottom-16 rotate-[5deg] white pill 'Export / React' (coral upload), both shadow-card, lg:flex only. ### Grain-textured panels — Several framed surfaces (hero mock, stats band, CTA panel, showcase card header) carry a faint dotted film-grain overlay for warmth and depth. Add class .grain to any relatively-positioned panel; .grain::before is a pseudo-element with content:'', position:absolute, inset:0, pointer-events:none, opacity:.4, background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.5) 1px, transparent 1px), background-size: 22px 22px. It sits above the panel's gradient/solid fill and below the content. ### Dark stats band with bordered metric cells — An inverted charcoal panel that breaks up the light page, with four metrics each marked by a thin coral/amber left border and amber/coral radial glows in the corners. A rounded-3xl bg-ink panel with two corner radial blur blobs (coral/50->amber/40 and amber/40->coral/30). Metrics in a responsive grid where each cell is border-l-2 in alternating coral/50 and amber/50 with pl-4, a text-4xl font-extrabold cream value, and a cream/45 uppercase tracked label. Headline uses cream text with the accent phrase in .sunset-text. ## Notas Especiais Frameless, fully responsive marketing landing page (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-7xl with px-6 -> lg:px-8 padding; feature grid reflows 3->2->1 col, showcase is lg:grid-cols-3 with a featured lg:row-span-2 tall card, footer is lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr], and all rows collapse to a single column on mobile; the nav is sticky + blurred. Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the custom colors (ink/coral/amber/cream/sand), the Plus Jakarta Sans font family, and the card/glow/soft shadows; Google Fonts loads Plus Jakarta Sans 400-800. Icons are inline Phosphor-style SVGs. All copy and the 'Solflare' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the warm sunset palette (coral #ff6b4a + amber #ffb020 on cream #fff8f1, with the .sunset-text gradient and coral/amber glow shadows) and the full-funnel SaaS landing structure (sticky nav -> gradient hero with product mock -> trust strip -> feature grid -> template showcase -> dark stats band -> testimonial -> gradient CTA -> dark footer), not the specific product.

style.description: Warm, optimistic, sunset-themed light mode: a cream/sand base lit by soft coral and amber radial blobs, with a coral-to-amber gradient used as the single hero accent (buttons, icon chips, gradient-clipped headline words, decorative blobs). Plus Jakarta Sans across the whole page, leaning on its 700/800 weights for display. Generous rounding (rounded-2xl/3xl/full pills), warm orange-tinted borders, and two custom soft shadows: a coral-tinted 'glow' on gradient elements and a low-contrast 'soft/card' lift on white surfaces. Dark sections (stats band, CTA panel, footer) flip to charcoal ink #1c1410 / burnt-orange gradient with the same coral+amber glows for contrast. A faint dotted radial 'grain' overlay (.grain::before) textures the framed panels.

style.prompt_typography: Plus Jakarta Sans only. Display headline text-5xl -> sm:text-6xl -> lg:text-[5.25rem], font-extrabold, leading-[1.03], tracking-tight. Section H2 text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight. Card H3 text-xl font-bold. Body text-base/text-sm leading-relaxed in ink/60-65. Eyebrow pills + stat labels are text-xs/[10px-11px] font-bold uppercase with wide tracking.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, vertically stacked, frameless responsive marketing page. Almost every section is centered inside mx-auto max-w-7xl with px-6 -> lg:px-8 padding (hero text narrows to max-w-4xl/xl, testimonial to max-w-4xl, CTA to max-w-6xl). Order top to bottom: sticky nav, hero (badge + headline + subcopy + 2 CTAs + product-mock card with floating chips + logo strip), feature grid (6 cards, 1->2->3 col), template showcase (3 cards, the first spanning 2 rows), dark stats band (2-col split: copy + 4 metrics), centered testimonial, burnt-orange gradient CTA panel, dark 4-column footer with bottom legal row. Grids reflow: features grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3; showcase grid lg:grid-cols-3 with the featured article lg:row-span-2; footer lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr]; everything collapses to one column on mobile.

special_ui_components.description: The recurring brand flourish: a key phrase in each big heading is rendered in a coral->orange->amber gradient clipped to the text, while the rest stays solid ink (or cream on dark sections).
special_ui_components.prompt: Define a .sunset-text utility: background: linear-gradient(96deg,#ff6b4a 0%,#ff8a3d 45%,#ffb020 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent. Wrap just the emphasis phrase in a <span class='sunset-text'> inside an otherwise solid heading (e.g. 'Ship a [SaaS site] that sells itself', 'From blank canvas to [shipped site]', 'Real [results].', '[three weeks]'). Use it sparingly, one phrase per heading, so the gradient reads as an accent not a wash.

special_ui_components.description: The primary CTA style: a fully rounded pill filled with the coral->amber gradient, white bold text, a trailing arrow glyph, and a warm coral glow shadow that brightens on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build with inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-coral to-amber px-7 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-glow transition hover:brightness-105, plus a trailing Phosphor arrow-right SVG. The secondary/ghost variant is white bg with an ink/15 border + shadow-soft that gains a coral/40 border and coral text on hover. On dark sections the primary flips to solid bg-ink (white text) against the burnt-orange panel.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive marketing landing page (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-7xl with px-6 -> lg:px-8 padding; feature grid reflows 3->2->1 col, showcase is lg:grid-cols-3 with a featured lg:row-span-2 tall card, footer is lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr], and all rows collapse to a single column on mobile; the nav is sticky + blurred. Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the custom colors (ink/coral/amber/cream/sand), the Plus Jakarta Sans font family, and the card/glow/soft shadows; Google Fonts loads Plus Jakarta Sans 400-800. Icons are inline Phosphor-style SVGs. All copy and the 'Solflare' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the warm sunset palette (coral #ff6b4a + amber #ffb020 on cream #fff8f1, with the .sunset-text gradient and coral/amber glow shadows) and the full-funnel SaaS landing structure (sticky nav -> gradient hero with product mock -> trust strip -> feature grid -> template showcase -> dark stats band -> testimonial -> gradient CTA -> dark footer), not the specific product.
